about.overview:
Welcome! Playing on Steam or STOVE? Keep Background (the default): it clicks the game window directly, so you can keep using your PC. Check the budget and stop key, then press Start Refresh.

Emulators and Google Play Games use Mouse or ADB instead. See Quickstart for the steps.

{tested_clients}

GUI and enhancements: NitrogenSulfide (Blue Natto)
Original refresh engine: Solunium
Epic Seven artwork: Smilegate and respective rights holders
Start/end sounds: Robin Lamb · CC0

Software licence: GNU GPL-3.0
Independent community tool.
about.quickstart:
Background mode (Epic Seven on Steam or STOVE)

1. Open English Epic Seven on Steam or STOVE at home or in Secret Shop. Close popups.
2. Background is selected by default. Press Start Refresh. You can keep using your PC; keep the pointer off the game window. Two monitors work best; on one monitor, cover the game if you like but never minimize it.
Playing on Google Play Games or an emulator? Background works only with Steam and STOVE: the banner offers Switch to Mouse.

Mouse mode (emulators; takes over your pointer)

1. Open English Epic Seven at home or in Secret Shop. Close popups.
2. Choose Control mode → Mouse. Select your game window; use Scan if needed.
3. Press Start Refresh. The app opens the shop if needed. Leave the PC alone; keep the game visible and its window still.

ADB mode

1. Enable/authorize emulator ADB debugging. Use English Epic Seven and a landscape 16:9 game view of at least 640 × 360.
2. Choose ADB → select your device. Google Developer Emulator: localhost:6520. Scan also lists open BlueStacks players by name and current port.
3. Start from home or Secret Shop. The app reveals idle home controls and opens the shop. You can use your PC mouse while ADB runs.

Before Start: check budget, delay and stop key. Keep calibration off for ordinary sessions. Both modes buy Covenant Bookmarks and Mystic Medals. Optionally enable Also buy Friendship Points for the current heart item (50 points for 18,000 gold per buy). Calibration excludes Friendship.
To stop: press your stop key or use Stop Session.

Mouse: resize before Start; game view must be at least 640 × 360.

Windows asks for administrator permission each time the app opens, because Steam and STOVE run Epic Seven as administrator. Choose Yes.
about.tested_clients: Tested: Background on Steam (Windows 11 and Linux) and STOVE; Mouse on STOVE and Google Play Games Developer Emulator; ADB on Google Play Games Developer Emulator. Other clients and setups have not been tested.
